title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the change in binding energy, Delta E = 2e^2 R^2 / (3a_0^3).

title: Perturbation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the perturbation Hamiltonian H' and the potential energy difference.

title: Integration Process
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration process to derive the energy correction from the perturbation.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the physical significance of the result, indicating that the binding energy decreases due to the proton's non-point-like nature.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the final expression for Delta E are consistent with energy units.

title: Sign of Delta E
description: Optional Criteria: The student should discuss the sign of Delta E and its physical implications regarding binding energy.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect limits of integration or sign mistakes in the potential energy terms.
